title: Valve your matchmaking is horrible for a reason
body: ### Description I came here after opening a ticket to steam support and them requesting me to post it here instead twice or three times. I just did not as I was done with your garbage matchmaking and to me you as a company are a lost cause. I am here now as I just finished a game and am furious and thought to hell with this, I am posting, it will most probably fall on deaf ears as is usual with you Valve. I am putting this under issues as it is an issue. I bought, yes bought and have been playing dota 2 since closed beta. I have over 10k hours in the game. I quit ranked years ago, around the time you introduced the role queing for the first time, I was done with the idiocy of your system and your refusal to do anything about it for years, it was too little, WAY too late. I started playing the even more horrendous normal matchmaking, with the thought that at least there is no mmr to worry and get angry about losing due to the incompetence of Valve at doing anything to the matchmaking positively. I did not post about it on reddit as people are so delusional over there that I thought it was pointless, all I will see are whiteknights and I am not posting this to get a reply from the community, I am posting this for you the devs to read. I have seen many time people who complain about the mmr system only to see replies saying no it is working as intended and you are where you belong etc and at the same time, people asking how to increase my mmr and all the replies were pick storm spirit, go mid... Yes indeed that is a sign that everything is working greatly! Not at all that there was something wrong with Storm Spirit, the heavy emphasis on the mid role etc, noooo... brainless people typing as usual on forums, which is why I do not take part in that kind of thing, it is pointless. If it was working, why did you Valve change it and introduced the role que as well as other changes back and forth, like the solo que etc? Yes because it works... Many years ago you announced that you were going to make dota and aside from talks about copyrights etc, the other common question was about the infamous toxicity of this particular community and what were you going to do about it. Your reply was that you knew about it and had plans for it. This was from interviews with IGN and the like. Those apparent plans was the reporting system, that is it. Aside from a system that did not work and resulted in more of the same behaviour, like a self fulfilling prophecy and it STILL does not work; you focus on the negative, you focus on the negative ONLY. There is this thing in psychology call operant conditioning, I am sure you have heard of this. Positive reinforcment, negative reinforcement and punishment. You focus on the negative only and even at that you fail(low priority and initial low prioirty). What about the positive? Oh well, "we have a commendation system!!" And what does it do? Ahhh nothing... For years, years I have said this, that if nothing else, the commendation system should be taken into consideration when matchmaking. I have a post dating 8 years now on reddit saying as much. It is all about probability and plausability, not possibility alone. An example of this is say you make commendations work per role. Old commendations stay if you want to see them or show them, but they are not taken into consideration in the new system, the new commendation has it's own counter. Say I have 2000 commends in support, another person has 1850 in offlane, one has 1900 in mid etc, we get matched together. What does this do? Well what are the chances, the PROBABILTY that a smurf/griefer/feeder/idiot/drunk/lowprofile etc is commended for their play let alone so much that they are placed with you; someone who actually plays the game and is at the very least, competent? Almost zero, if not zero. Even if you can make an argument and say ok, but what if you play another role and you do not have commends in that role, you will be placed lower and have to farm commends which would be a problem etc. Ok then fix that problem or find another solution that is a POSITIVE one as opposed to the horrendous negativity that is the matchmaking(ranked or not) of this game, but do something... positive. Match making right now is utter garbage. Every game and I mean EVERY in a literal manner, not figurative, I see smurf profiles (which I can deal with, but the others do not because they are asleep and do not know that magic knowledge that only I do of say, orb of corrosion, shivas and skadi deal with regen heroes WHO KNEW!!!!! as an example) feeders, griefers that I have reported a million times and disliked, yet still your system matches me with people I do not want to be matched with ever again and they are not having a bad day, their entire profile is made for griefing, every game they do the same thing, but nope, nothing, they are allowed to stay in dota and on steam of course cause HATS! Right? And no I am not subscribing to dota plus just for that "feature". This is even in unranked, again I quit ranked years ago and am not going back to it again. Even in the case of winning, if you really count your games, if you go in your matches and make a study, your wins are 98% of time stomps as well due to the same reason but there were more on the opposing team. You see dota is NOT at all a game of skill, do not kid yourselves, dot is a game of luck. It goes like an auction. Who has the most idiots loses, the minimum is one per each team and that is me beign very generous. Do I hear 2 idiots, 2 idiots on team dire. Do I hear 2 on radiant? 2 on radiant! Do I hear 3 on Dire? no? Do I hear 3 on Radiant? 3 on radiant! Dire wins! - dota 2 Your matchmaking system is the worst system made for anything in anything, not gaming, not IT, on the planet, you could not think up something this backwards if you tried. This resulted in me beign extremely negative towards your game and have been for a while, hence me quitting ranked and have been playing other games as alternatives, looking for a game that makes me say goodbye to dota for good. This is not a good thing, you have a game that on paper is good, people like, but a matchmaking system that makes people hate the game(why did Gabe Newell say he too hs a love hate relationship hmm? Maybe address that??? You are not doing anything about it. The fact that when I report people in game and see that it went through and I see that per day I have multiple people I reported that got punished is NOT A GOOD THING as you think. Sure it is good to know from a player's perspective, but from a developer's perspective when you keep cutting the tip as opposed to going to the root of the problem and addressing that, is very telling on what is wrong with this game and you as developers. If every day millions of players are being reported, that is not a good thing. It is not a celebratory thing to say ah look they are getting punished, the reports are going through, sit back and relax, mission accomplished, that is a red flag that these is something horribly wrong with your game. At the very least tf2. Ah yes, you remember tf2 right? The brilliant game that you killed for this, had a blacklist(still negative). People asked for it for years and after 2 centuries you introduced it, in dota plus... as a paid feature, put behind a subscription pay wall. I have said that these things before, I have said that the changed report system does not work and is easily abused and I am getting reported by groups when THEY ARE THE ONES griefing you. Again, one more time, you get in games, it is a party, they proceed to grief you for no reason and you report them, but you end up getting reported because of how backards your system is and so easily abused, and nothing of course done by you, but Quinn says it, Oh no not Quinn!! Lo and behold Quinn! Quickly get on it, fix this! What an amazing feeling to be the one who is actually playing and helping and get punished for it MULTIPLE TIMES! Oh yeah this will not intern turn people to grief themselves, nooooo. Hey real quick, what happened with drm again? It worked right? It did not at all backfire and turn legit consumers to pirate as they saw that they were the ones affected and being punished while the pirated were completely unaffected, hmm?. Yeah this makes me want to play your game more Valve! Brilliant. It was your own Chet Faliszek who said that review bombing was a result of players having no place to voice their concerns. It is a means of communication in itself. This is how I feel towards Dota and Valve all together, it feels like that. I am posting this as I just had a game where I was supporting the offlaner, we dominated our lane, our safelane was spamming requesting gank, so I teleported to them(yes them, 2) and we dealt with what was going on and gave them their lane back. Our midder goes afk jungle and after the game, I find myself reported and unable to find a match. This is not a joke. I not only play my heart out, I help my offaner, then tp to help a person in need all game. We get a griefer and I am the one reported of course. This kind of thing makes me want to communicate with you Valve using extreme physical violence, while chanting "volvo giff diretide. We espn now. Gaben gaben memes memes reddit" as this is the only means of communication that works apparently right? You made it very clear with the Diretide fiasco, how to communicate with Valve and what works, funny your P.S no need to go to innocent car manufacturers was so pathetic as if anything THIS was the ONLY thing that got a response from you in your ivory tower. Just like the courier feeding, you had to be called out by a pro player on social media to finally after mere YEARS do something about it, and on top of that, what was the solution? Something there all along in dota 1. I recall on dev.dota a forum made by whom? You valve, you made that forum and there was a section made by also you to report people, profiles etc. This was a long time ago obviously. I recall reporting an IO player who did nothing all game but ult and tp his own teammates to the enemy fountian the moment he got his ult. I immediately unchecked the box for help etc and told the other player who just got griefed to do the same and EXPLAINED it to him on mic and typed it in chat so he knows how to do it until he did, the other players on my team could not take the hint and do it too, noooo they had to be told ONE BY ONE, no joke, one by one how to do it after IO switched to them and they died. This is of course proof that your matchmaking works, I am matched with people of the same IQ level as me, that is why I knew how to do it and they did not and did not have the presence on mind to do it as I explained it, nooooo they had to be fed one by one to do it. Brilliant matchmaking. Anyway after that I looked at the person's dota buff and saw that all of his games were IO and NP where he just tps to the enem fountain and feeds nonstop. All of his games were like, ALL. I report the profile, the dota buff and match id were also given on said forum made by whom? Made by YOU Valve! and for what reason? For reporting this kind of profiles and behaviour and what did I get as a response? You have/had an emplyee called Kryll or something similar and he said we do not do or take any action against these things.... wow, just wow. I have a feeling that the commendation being taken into account partially from a recent update was due to me spamming you with it when I ended it up reporting people in dota and their steam as well as I was fed up and frustrated with this horrendous garbage that is your matchmaking and even then, you half ass it, you do not implement it correctly and fully and what do we get? You have no rights (de facto), you end up in dirty prisons, corruption, prison culture, gangs. Once you enter it - you're labeled as the criminal and your life changes that way forever. You actually still have rights. You are being detached from the society but you still have access to some amenities, you can sometimes watch tv, you have your attorney visiting you, working on your case, etc. You are to be restored as a functional member of society. title: Петиция о полном удалении системы Communication Score в Dota 2
body: ### Description Адресат: Valve / команда разработки Dota 2 Настоящим мы обращаемся с требованием полного удаления системы Communication Score из Dota 2 как системно неисправной и наносящей прямой вред качеству игры. Данный вывод сделан не на основании единичного инцидента, а по итогам многолетнего использования системы и массовой реакции игрового сообщества. За годы существования Communication Score на форуме Steam были созданы тысячи тем, в которых игроки независимо друг от друга описывают одни и те же проблемы: непрозрачность, непредсказуемость наказаний и отсутствие реального пути восстановления. Ключевые проблемы системы Отсутствие проверки содержания коммуникации Система опирается на репорты, которые не проходят валидацию по содержанию. Она не различает токсичное поведение, активную игровую коммуникацию и просто обильное общение. В результате наказываются не только токсичные игроки, но и: новички, активно задающие вопросы; лидеры, дающие коллы и координирующие команду; любые «заметные» игроки, чаще взаимодействующие с командой. Непрозрачный и нестабильный вес репортов Репорты имеют неочевидный и непредсказуемый вес. В одних случаях несколько репортов не приводят к заметным последствиям, в других — один репорт способен вызвать резкое падение Communication Score (сотни или тысячи очков) без объяснения причин. Это делает систему недоверяемой и невоспроизводимой. Наказания без причинно-следственной связи На практике фиксируются случаи, когда репорты от игроков вражеской команды применяются даже при отсутствии токсичной коммуникации. Репорт может быть следствием поражения и эмоциональной реакции, но система не отличает такие ситуации от реальных нарушений. Отсутствие работающего механизма восстановления Даже при сотнях матчей, положительной статистике, минимальном количестве репортов и большом числе лайков Communication Score может: не расти месяцами; обрушиваться за несколько игр без объяснимых причин. Это означает, что система не имеет корректного «конечного состояния выхода» из наказания. Критический ущерб командной игре и соревновательной целостности Автоматические мьюты: напрямую ухудшают качество матчей; лишают команды координации; влияют на исходы побед и поражений. Особенно критично это в premade-группах. Игроки объединяются в группы именно для командной игры и координации. Любые автоматические ограничения общения в таких условиях противоречат самой цели групповой игры и наносят максимальный ущерб. Избыточность системы В Dota 2 уже существуют достаточные и эффективные инструменты индивидуальной фильтрации: mute, ignore, отключение чата и голосовой связи. Эти инструменты позволяют каждому игроку самостоятельно решать, кого он хочет слышать, не нарушая симметрию матчей и не ограничивая остальных. Communication Score не добавляет новой ценности и дублирует функции, уже реализованные более корректно. Деградация коммуникационной среды за годы использования За более чем три года существования Communication Score: токсичность в игре не была устранена; при этом нормальная, полезная командная коммуникация практически исчезла. Игроки массово предпочитают молчать из страха получить репорт, даже когда общение повышает шансы на победу. Это подтверждается как личным опытом, так и тысячами обсуждений на официальном форуме Steam. Требование На основании изложенного мы требуем полного удаления системы Communication Score из Dota 2 как: неремонтопригодной по дизайну; непрозрачной и непредсказуемой; избыточной при наличии альтернатив; наносящей прямой вред качеству матчей и командной игре. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

author: AnAncientOne

title: Communication Score/ Вежливость
body: **Current status** Complete silence and ignoring from Valve **What became clear after the discussion** Based on the discussion in this thread, the analysis of other topics, and publicly available information, it became obvious that the problem is not about isolated "edge cases" or specific numbers. This is about the system logic itself and its impact on teamplay. In its current implementation, Communication Score in the long run is primarily driven by report and mute statistics, not by the actual quality or context of communication. At the same time, text and voice analysis is mostly used for fast punishments (mutes), but it does not solve the problem of cumulative score degradation. **Why staying silent does not protect you** Silence is not a protection, because the "Politeness" score can decrease even when there is no communication at all. This means a complete absence of any interaction: no pings, no voice chat, no text messages. By design, the "Politeness" metric is supposed to reflect the quality of communication. In practice, however, it can change without any communication happening. In other words, a metric tied to communication continues to drop even when communication does not exist. **Main problem: the system breaks teamplay** The core issue is that the system restricts communication without addressing the root causes of conflicts. When the score drops, a player loses the ability to interact properly with the team, while still being placed into matches where communication is critically important. In Dota, communication is not a bonus or a "nice-to-have feature". It is the foundation of team-based gameplay. Calls, timings, cooldown information, and positioning directly affect fights and match outcomes. When part of the team is restricted, the match loses symmetry of conditions, and overall match quality degrades for everyone. In practice it looks like this: you see an opportunity for coordinated action, but due to restrictions you cannot call a timing or request support. Coordination is replaced by guessing and randomness. Even with high "politeness" values, some players remain restricted, while others avoid active communication because of fear of reports. As a result, communication becomes one-sided or disappears completely. **What I propose to discuss in this thread** The real question is no longer about how to "recover" or "farm" politeness score. The question is: why does the game have a system that in its current form does not improve behavior, but instead limits a core gameplay tool and reduces match quality. My assumption is that this system was introduced to increase retention and inflate online numbers. Players tolerated it for several years. That patience is gone. **I propose to focus the discussion on this: the system logic, its transparency, and its impact on the match as a whole. And whether it should be fundamentally reworked or ##disabled. Without a radical redesign, the "Politeness" system causes more harm than benefit.** Main link to the topic - It's time for VALVE to wake up **Внимание!** Система вежливости является системой удерживания игркоов, а не борьбы с токсичностью **Что стало понятно по итогам обсуждения** По результатам обсуждения в этом топике, анализа других тем и доступной информации стало очевидно, что проблема не сводится к отдельным "частным случаям" или конкретным цифрам. Речь идет о логике работы системы и ее влиянии на командную игру. В текущей реализации communication score в долгосрочной перспективе в первую очередь зависит от статистики репортов и мутов, а не от качества и контекста коммуникации. При этом анализ текста и голоса используется в основном для быстрых санкций (мутов), но не решает проблему накопительного падения показателя. **Почему молчание не защищает** Молчание не является защитой, потому что показатель "Вежливости" может снижаться даже при полном отсутствии коммуникации. Речь идет именно об отсутствии любой информации от игрока: нет пингов, нет голосового чата, нет текстовых сообщений. При этом "Вежливость" по своему назначению должна отражать качество коммуникации. Но на практике она может изменяться без самой коммуникации как таковой. То есть показатель, связанный исключительно с общением, может продолжить снижаться даже тогда, когда общения просто не существует. **Главная проблема: система ломает командную игру** Ключевая проблема в том, что система ограничивает коммуникацию, не устраняя первопричины конфликтов. При падении показателя игрок лишается возможности полноценно взаимодействовать с командой, но при этом продолжает играть в матчах, где коммуникация критически важна. В Dota коммуникация - это не бонус и не "приятная опция", а основа командной игры. Коллы, тайминги, информация о кулдаунах и позициях напрямую влияют на исход драк и матча. Когда часть команды ограничена в общении, матч теряет симметрию условий, и качество игры падает для всех. На практике это выглядит так: ты видишь момент для совместных действий, но из-за ограничений не можешь обозначить тайминг или запросить поддержку. Координация заменяется угадыванием и везением. Даже при высоких значениях "вежливости" часть команды может сидеть под ограничениями, а другая часть начинает избегать активного общения из-за страха репортов. В итоге коммуникация становится односторонней либо исчезает полностью. **Что предлагаю обсуждать в теме** Поэтому вопрос уже не в том, как "поднять" или "отмыть" вежливость. Вопрос в другом: зачем в игре существует система, которая в текущем виде не исправляет поведение, а ограничивает ключевой инструмент и ухудшает качество матчей. Мое предположение, что систему сделали, для удержания и повышение онлайна. Мы терпели эту систему несколько лет, терпение кончилось. **Предлагаю обсуждать именно это: логику системы, прозрачность и влияние на матч в целом. И как ее исправить, или отключить. Без радикальной переработки система "Вежливости" наносит больше вреда, чем пользы.** Основная ссылка на тему - Пришло Время проснутся VALVE

title: Communication score as a feature doesn't work in it's current iteration.
body: ### Description As of right now if by some means the player's communication score dips below 10k, they will be placed with players that have similar comm score, in the sub10k range of this sphere players are very likely to report other players for simply playing bad, or players on the other team for hating said player for whatever reason. This creates a non-ending loop where unless the player plays perfectly, is unable to avoid being reported and even then it is still likely that they will be reported. As of now the only ways of gaining comm score, is not getting reported, or not playing for months. As you can see from the above this gets problematic, as even if the player doesn't communicate at all, they can still be reported for communication abuse. I believe chatwheels shouldn't count here as at that rate you might aswell mute the player because no matter what happens, they'll likely get reported. Communication is vital for an enjoyable game, but the feature in it's current form just doesn't allow this once you go below 10k. title: Bug with smurf-identifying system
body: ### Description Hello Vavle! I have to post this in bugs, because in common Steam Support your empoyees don't read my ticket and just copy-paste the same answer without any explainations I ask them to give. So, smurf-system identified my account as a smurf, but it is not. So I think I can post it in bugs. Also, I am tired of posting many ticket, so I will copy-paste one of them, sorry for it. That it is: "Please, read my ticket until the end and give me a detailed answer on my ticket to avoid more tickets in future. I know that you have many of them and I don't want to spam you. I respect the work of your employees. So i wouldn't contact you one more time if there were no worthy reason. I feel that I can be a bit annoying for you because of creating one more ticket, but you still haven't explained me the reason i got match-making ban on this account. And I am still having an opinion, that was not fair. Firstly, in the ticket on Feb, 9 when I started to play on this account, I asked you if it is allowed. And you said that it is allowed, you said: ** Multiple accounts playing on the same PC is not considered smurfing ** I'm not sharing my accounts and I'm not using someone's else accounts. Both of my Steam accounts are linked to the same phone number. And I always play from the same laptop. Secondly, in every our ticket you linked me 'Smurfing is not welcome in Dota'. I've read it before playing this account. And it is said there: ** Smurf accounts are alternate accounts used by players to avoid playing at the correct MMR, to abandon games, to cheat, to grief, or to otherwise be toxic without consequence ** I didn't played Ranked on this account, I don't abandon games, I don't cheat, I don't grief, I'm always concentrated on game and even my teammates are not friendly I try to communicated with them to win the game. I am not toxic in my games, my behaviour and communication scores are always growing. Also about ranked, I said to you in the first ticket, that I gonna try play on both accounts at almost the same MMR, but on different Ranked Roles for not ruining games for my teammates by the reason I'm not playing on my main Role. I have around 2900 MMR on main account, And I think you know that on those ratings the real skill range in a single game is very wide. I also said to you in previous tickets before that I gonna improve MMR on both my accounts step by step and frequently play on both of them, so there will be fair matchmaking. And also your calibration system will set me the correct rating it calculates. I am not going to intentionally lose or artificially upgrade my rating. And i repeat one more time that you said that it is allowed to play on this account and the main one this way. Thirdly, you said, that ban for matchmaking is done if player had recieved a warning that he/she should stop playing on smurfs before and ignored it. I haven't recieve any warnings on both my accounts. But you said that: **my account was either identified as a smurf, or is my main but I have continued to play on smurf accounts.** This account is not smurf and I explained why, I didn't recieved any warnings. Also I was playing an ability draft and have good winrate there because i know many good skill combinations. Maybe theese are the reason why system considered me as a smurf, but for real i am not. title: Nonsensical workings of communication score system and its rampant abuse
body: ### Description When exactly are you guys going to address the comically insane system you so nonchalantly deployed? 3 weeks ago I had 11700 comm score, throughout a month of my gameplay a message informing me im being reported above average popped up for me very game, even tho I couldn even remember when was the last time I got mad or told someone off, there was absolutely nothing in my comm history (at least I thought so at the time) to mark my account so I didnt pay much attention to it, as my comm score kept consistently rising despite said warning - which is absolutely absurd by the way and highlights the insanity of your system. Suddenly, in a range of 2 days, my comm score dropped by almost 2000 and I had no idea what the hell even triggered it. Then I started paying attention to what is happening and what I found out is just out of this world, I honestly cant say if you guys are trolling the community or are absolutely incompetent at this point. My comm score was dropped by 2000 right after a streak of around 12 games in a row (played on EU west servers with english language set as preffered - things that do not mean anything because of how poorly they are enforced) where I got a team of at least 3, if not 4 russians/ukrainians writing and shouting things in cyrilic/russian language, and when I dared to say "this is EU server, speak english so I can understand otherwise I will mute you" I got automatically reported for comm abuse by 70% of the players according to opendota stats, which resulted in my comm score being dropped by 2000 points in a span of two days. Do you understand the issue that I just reported? A player speaking english language, playing on EU west servers, with english language set as preffered merely asks russian parties to speak english otherwise he will mute them as there is no point in listening to ramblings in russian language for him - and HE IS THE ONE PENALIZED FOR COMMUNICATION ABUSE. Now as insane and absurd as that is, I noticed that my comm score is not rising even tho I stopped requesting mentally unstable russian speakers to speak english on EU servers so I dont get reported for literally askinng to follow the games rules and the most basic common sense, not only it was not rising - it kept declining. I could not understand what in the world is happening and then I noticed that in few of the games I suddenly got "muted for the rest of the match" and my voice comms got blocked. You want to know how that happened? In one of the games I said "that was **fucking** amazing", approximately 30 seconds after that a guy says "sry muting you all, im listening to music" and BOOM I suddenly got muted for the rest of the match and my comms score dropped for 300 points right after that. Wow, just wow. Your imbecilic automated system flagged my message as "toxic" because of a curseword and in combination with me being muted by a single player, system stripped me of any comm priviledges and subtracted hundreds of points from my comm score again. Amazing. In another game, a carry I supported said "nigga pls block the camp", 10 minutes later he praised me for a play I made and I typed "Im your nigger, dont worry bro". 5 minutes later a clearly unstable guy that could not for the world stop attacking my teammates muted me, because I typed "im done with you dude, muted", he replied "same" and BOOM, I have been muted for the rest of the match with another almost 400 points subtracted from my comm score after the game. The toxic player attacking others was not, no, it was me for using something your demented system apparently recognises as "racial slur" and since I already had a low comm score and another player muted me (for daring to tell him I am muting him, because I refuse to lisiten to him any longer). Absurdity after absurdity, the more I started paying attention to the exact words I use and the timing of the triggers, the more I realized this new scoring system for which I was honestly stoked at the beginning is completely insane and broken, aswell as regularly abused by parties of players invading EU servers and refusing to speak english, not only that - reporting anyone who requests them to. Combine that with obviously abhorrent weight system you set your system to use - 40 commends in the span of 6 games + 3 reports for comm abuse = 450 comms points subtracted, I actually do not know if I can continue playing this game. What kind of logic is that? Do you know how absolutely insanely frustrating it is to receive commends from almost every member of your team plus some enemies, being literally praised in after-game chat as "oh my god youre nice bro" and still seeing your comm score falling and falling? How the hell am I meant to stop this completely broken and inescapeable spiral? By not communicating at all? IN A TEAM BASED ONLINE GAME DEPENDENT ON COLLABORATION? WHAT??! Do not get me wrong - I am a dota player for more than 17 years by now, I am fully aware of how toxic this community always have been and its only been getting worse by the rampage of mental disorders and general mental instability over past few years, I am rooting for this system to work and to condition players to behave like humans between each other, but the current state is so tragically undercooked and insanity inducing you are literally forcing non-toxic members of community to stop play the game completely. I have combed through this git for a few minutes and I can see that a good chunk of the bug reports being about comm/behaviour system behaving unexpectedly without a single answer in any of them. Now of course, we can ignore a good half of them by deducing those are the rotten apples that need to be conditioned just lashing out because they are finally meeting consequences after years of being accustomed to toxicity as being natural, but almost nothing I have personally endured over past few weeks in the context of comm score system can be considered natural, logical or working as intended. When and how are you planning on addressing this absurd problem? The issue reports are clearly being looked at since you are deleting all the @mention comments, yet you cannot be bothered to actually reply to any of them or do at least a basic profilaxy or monitoring of the system it seems. You ignore the problem for everyone except a few pro players/talent members that make waves on socials about it. So the question we have to ask is simple but very relevant - are you trying to kill off your own game? ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Progressive FPS degradation appears to be related to dota2.com — blocking the domain prevents the performance loss
body: ### Description Dota 2 progressively loses performance during a single client session. FPS decreases both within an individual match and across consecutive matches while the same Dota 2 process remains running. I found a reproducible workaround: blocking dota2.com through the Windows hosts file almost completely prevents the progressive FPS degradation. The entry is: `0.0.0.0 dota2.com` This does not block the actual game servers. Matchmaking and normal matches continued to work during my tests. System configuration CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 7700 GPU: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16 GB RAM: 32 GB DDR5 OS: Windows 11 Pro Resolution: 2560 × 1440 Refresh rate: 320 Hz Rendering API: Vulkan Changing graphics settings has very little effect on the degradation pattern, so this does not appear to be a normal GPU bottleneck. ### Behavior without blocking dota2.com After a fresh launch of Dota 2: First match: start: approximately 300–310 FPS; after around 15 minutes: 200–220 FPS; end of the match: approximately 185–190 FPS. If the client is not restarted, the next match already starts at a significantly lower performance level. Second match: start: approximately 200–210 FPS; end: around 160 FPS. The following match may start at only around 180 FPS. If I continue playing using the same Dota 2 process, performance eventually degrades to approximately 100–110 FPS. In other words, each subsequent match appears to inherit part of the performance loss from the previous one. ### A/B test with dota2.com I repeated the test after adding the following line to the Windows hosts file: `0.0.0.0 dota2.com` I then ran: `ipconfig /flushdns` and fully restarted Dota 2. I played three consecutive matches without restarting the client between them. The result was significantly different: the progressive degradation was almost completely gone. Even after three consecutive matches, average FPS remained around 300. The behavior can be summarized approximately as: Normal: Match 1: ~310 → ~190 FPS Match 2: ~210 → ~160 FPS Match 3+: starts progressively lower Long session: ~100–110 FPS possible dota2.com blocked: Match 1: ~300 FPS Match 2: ~300 FPS Match 3: ~300 FPS Absolute FPS naturally varies depending on what is happening in the match, but the progressive loss between matches is almost completely absent when the domain is blocked. ### Network observations I also captured Dota 2 traffic with Wireshark. The client regularly connects to: `dota2.com` It also uses: `cdn.dota2.com` including for Dota React assets and video content. However, the workaround described above blocks only: `dota2.com` `cdn.dota2.com` was not blocked during this test. This does not prove the exact root cause, but it provides a reproducible way to significantly change the behavior of the problem. It may be worth investigating web/dashboard/Panorama content associated with dota2.com for resource accumulation or background work that persists during long client sessions. ### Additional observation The command: `map_enable_portrait_worlds 0` also produces a noticeable performance improvement. However, it is not a usable workaround because it breaks Dark Carnival and other UI elements that depend on background worlds. This may be related, but I have not confirmed a direct connection. ### Steps to reproduce Fully close and freshly launch Dota 2. Keep graphics settings, resolution and FPS limit unchanged. Play several normal matches consecutively without restarting Dota. Compare FPS at the beginning and end of each match. Observe that subsequent matches begin at progressively lower FPS. Close Dota 2. Add the following entry to the Windows hosts file: 0.0.0.0 dota2.com Run: ipconfig /flushdns Launch Dota 2 again. Play another three consecutive matches. Compare the FPS degradation between the two tests. On my system, the second test almost completely prevents the progressive FPS degradation. ### Expected behavior With unchanged settings and comparable scene complexity, performance should not continuously decrease simply because several matches have been played using the same Dota 2 process. Ending a match should release or reset resources that could otherwise reduce the performance of the following match. ### Actual behavior Without blocking dota2.com, FPS progressively decreases during a match and continues to deteriorate across subsequent matches. With dota2.com blocked, this cumulative degradation is almost completely absent, and performance remains close to its initial level even after three consecutive matches. ### Workaround side effects Blocking dota2.com affects Dota's web content. Some news, patch notes, videos, or other dashboard content may no longer load. For that reason, I am not suggesting this as a proper fix. I am reporting it as a diagnostic observation that may help identify the underlying issue. ### Related issues This appears related to: #35002 — Progressive FPS degradation across consecutive matches #35311 — Severe FPS degradation during a match / very low GPU utilization This report adds the observation that blocking dota2.com almost completely prevents the degradation on my system. ### Diagnostic data available I can provide: full Wireshark captures; separate captures for Home, Armory, Dark Carnival and Match; DNS/TLS connection data; FPS comparisons before and after the hosts change; additional controlled A/B tests; ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Overwatch Conviction Feedback – Potential False Positive
body: ### Description Hello, I would like to provide feedback regarding the Dota 2 Overwatch system after recently receiving a 4-hour matchmaking restriction followed by 3 Single Draft wins. I understand and fully support the purpose of the Overwatch system. It is an important tool for keeping the game fair and reducing griefing and toxic behavior. However, I believe my recent conviction was a false positive. In the match that led to my restriction, I did not intentionally grief, feed, destroy items, go AFK, or sabotage my team in any way. I simply played the game to the best of my ability. Unfortunately, I was reported by teammates, most likely because we lost the match or they were frustrated with my performance. What concerns me is not only my own case, but the possibility that other players may also receive Overwatch convictions despite not intentionally ruining games. A player having a bad match or making mistakes should not automatically be considered griefing. I would like to suggest that the Overwatch system could be improved by: Placing greater emphasis on objective gameplay evidence rather than the outcome of the match or the number of reports. Applying stricter standards before issuing matchmaking restrictions. Adding additional verification for borderline Overwatch cases to reduce false convictions. Continuously reviewing the accuracy of the system to ensure that innocent players are not penalized. I am not asking for special treatment. I simply hope the system continues to improve so that punishments are applied only to players who genuinely intend to ruin games. Thank you for your time and for your continued work on Dota 2. title: Not a bug, but a feature/update
body: Good day dear Valve, After watching TI, I came up with many questions and ideas, but one thing I’m sure about for now is the item Outworld Staff. I believe it is too overpowered, and at the same time too dependent on luck. For example, in the game with Satanic on Juggernaut and Ame, it was clear how strongly this item affects the gameplay. I also have some concerns about the mechanics of Juggernaut’s ultimate. It feels way too outdated — it has been more than 10 years, and the only real change was switching from strike count to attack speed and mechanics. Its cooldown is also far too long. Here are my suggestions: Outworld Staff — either remove it entirely, or make its effect similar to Dark Willow’s, with the possibility of dispelling it by Nullifier. Here’s why: if luck favors a team, they could have 2–3 Outworld Staffs, so even if you buy Nullifier, you’re forced to choose who to focus. I think this would bring balance. Omnislash — I have two ideas here: Change the Aghanim’s effect so that it works more like Genji’s ultimate from Overwatch. Juggernaut would enter a state where, if he attacks a hero within range, he jumps to them with Omnislash. If he kills someone and still has 1 second left on the effect, he gains another second and can keep moving, slashing again. Or, alternatively, make Aghanim (or maybe Shard, up to you) give Juggernaut an additional passive effect: if he exits Omnislash, he has 0.5 seconds to recast it or perform an attack, and if an enemy is still within range, the ultimate continues for the remaining duration. That’s about it for now… maybe I’ll come up with more interesting ideas and write to you again. Hugs to you, with respect and kindness, Kirai P.S. Please don’t forget about our beloved Dota… we all love her very much ❤️

body: ### Description Overview: At the conclusion of each random matchmaking game, introduce a voting system that allows players to indicate if they want to continue playing together as a party for the next game. How it Works: Voting Prompt: After the game ends, all players see a prompt: “Do you want to continue as a group for the next game?” Voting Mechanism: Players can select “Yes” or “No.” Result: All players who vote “Yes” will be grouped together and automatically queued for the next game. title: Behavior system NEEDS AN OVERHAUL
body: ### Description There is a reason why LOL 5x'd its player-base while Dota on march break had a declining trend of players. The average game experience as of a year ago feels worse than it ever did. The devs over complicate matchmaking and behavior systems that have repeatedly done more harm than good. As a consequence of not retaining players, queueing at certain times leads to insanely long queues in many regions, and suggestions from the community keep being ignored. Some intent is needed on making the core experience better, not adding tangential minigames. Marketing the game also more appropriately for the kind of prizes on tournaments also makes more sense, and not going silent for years while ignoring glaring issues the community raises. Yes there is a fear of smurfs but valve is already doing nothing about it. A yearly ban does NOT cut it. Moreover, high profile previously banned players like Mason are still playing the game and streaming it. Implement significantly more harsh deterrents Punishments currently are a complete joke. They dont deter nor do they even come close to any sort of reform. Taking away post game drops and coaching... seriously, does any player on earth care about this? ranked temp bans should be a thing, or forcing players to play 200 regular games to re access rank. 3 strikes and a temp ban should be the norm and a fourth being a permanent ban. Valves fear of smurfs and banning their toxic cash cows has made new players less likely to stick around and stifled the games growth at the peril of other players. Give players also a visible warning when their behavior is being reported at a high rate (textbox that cant be dismissed or something of the sort). This used to be a thing in DOTA, and is no longer. Also single draft was a fun game mode, now its dead since its the default LP mode. If you want players to go over a more painful experience, make them play a match at 0.5x speed. Commends mean absolutely nothing, and there are no good incentives for behavior: Solution. Rework commends into having meaning and impact. Implement a scaling behavior system visible to other players. Say 12k behavior score is the average, it is far too often you see toxic players in it, clearly there are better behaved players within 12k than others. So break the cap above 12k to lets say 20k BUT it gets progressively harder to mantain any score above 12k. You can tie higher BS to actual rewards players would be happy to recieve. If you give players one or two endorsement votes at the end of the match to use on players they enjoyed playing with you can generate a system where actual good behavior can stand out. To be in lets say 15k you'd be getting endorsed every other game, above 17k every game, some gradient like that. The endorsement system similar to the Blizzard Overwatch and LOL was very effective, they have used it for more than 10 years. Endorsement level can be a visible medal, and should be rewarded when high. Currently 12k behavior means nothing now, too many toxic players on whats supposed to be the highest behavior bracket. De-centivize knee jerk inaccurate reporting With more accurate data you can make better decisions. Anyone that reports for EVERY CATEGORY altogether should have its reports ignored. Encourage players to report accurately. Thank players for using overwatch and notify them when action is taken. Spam reporters should be taken less seriously AND they should know about it. If a players report everyone in a match there is no credible reason to take them seriously for the next one unless they start reporting with intent. The current system gives the illusion of multiple reports and has some measures for spam reporting, however they simply take the first report at face value. Example, games where the enemy team stomps (and losses in genera) usually lead to cores being reported, you see this all the time in overwatch and is exacerbated by smurfs being able to ruin lower rank games. With cleaner data you can measure a trust factor on each player and more accurately determine if a set of reports should lead to action or not. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Doom's ultimate "Doom" can be cast on allied Doom (mirror matchup) and regular creeps, applying full mute and damaging
body: ### Ability name Doom ### Description **Patch:** 7.41f Doom's ultimate ability `Doom` can be cast on an allied hero **only if that hero is also Doom** (mirror matchup). On any other allied hero, the ability correctly fails to cast. When cast on an allied Doom, the ability applies the full `Doom` debuff: complete mute (no abilities, no items) and healing prevention. The ally also takes periodic damage from the Aghanim's Scepter aura, which incorrectly treats them as an enemy. The ability can also be cast on **regular creeps** (lane and neutral) regardless of the matchup. It applies the debuff and periodic damage. Ancient creeps and Roshan correctly reject the cast. ### Expected behavior Doom should not be castable on any allied hero or any non-hero unit. The fact that it only works on an allied Doom and on regular creeps proves this is a targeting validation bug, not intended behavior. ### Steps to reproduce **Reproduce on allied Doom:** 1. Pick Doom in Demo Mode with a second Doom as an ally (mirror matchup). 2. Buy Aghanim's Scepter. 3. Target the allied Doom with your ultimate. 4. Ability casts successfully, ally Doom gets muted and takes aura damage. **Reproduce on a creep (neutral or lane):** 1. Pick Doom in Demo Mode. 2. Target a regular lane or neutral creep (not Ancient). 3. Ability casts successfully, creep gets Doom debuff and periodic damage. ### Note - The creep bug works both **with and without** Aghanim's Scepter. - The ally-Doom bug only occurs when Aghanim's Scepter is equipped. ### Videos All tests are shown in the attached videos: ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) 9006843945 — 10:01, 12:21, 14:50

title: Improving Team Communication with a Visual Help Notification
body: ### Description 1. Current Problem The quick chat wheel is the main tool for communicating with allies. However, it is often ineffective because: Many players ignore the chat. Some use "allmute" and disable chat entirely. Result: Until you reach a high rank, requests for help are frequently ignored. This negatively affects the overall gameplay experience, especially for lower MMR players. 2. Proposed Solution Add an option to send a visible notification to all allies when a player needs assistance, similar to the notification that appears when a teammate purchases a key item. How it would work: A player can request help from the entire team. The request can be sent once every N seconds (to prevent spam). The notification appears in a prominent on-screen window, just like important item purchase alerts. 3. Expected Benefits Provides a clear and obvious signal even for players with low MMR or those who mute chat. Partially reduces the impact of unresponsive teammates. Encourages players to think about teamplay opportunities and respond to calls for help. 4. Additional Notes This system would not replace normal communication, but would serve as a reliable complement to existing tools. The cooldown limit would prevent notification spam. title: The abysmal matchmaking system has rendered the game unplayable.
body: I am a Dota 2 player with over 10 years of experience and a long-term paying user. I want to raise this very directly: The current matchmaking system is severely damaging the gameplay experience, and this is no longer an occasional issue — it has become consistent and systemic. Here is what I am experiencing: • In many losing matches, there is a clear and significant gap in actual skill level between teammates and opponents This is not normal performance variance — some teammates clearly do not meet the basic skill level expected for the bracket, and in some cases appear to have no understanding of how to play properly • At the same time, these matches frequently include extremely poor player behavior Including but not limited to: griefing, playing solo without participation, constant arguing, and disruptive behavior Mute and block functions are ineffective because the frequency of such players appearing is abnormally high • Winning matches also present a problem Many games are heavily dominated by one player who is clearly far above the current bracket, effectively deciding the outcome early These “free wins” provide no real gameplay experience either What I want to emphasize is: I am not asking to win every game, and I do not expect perfect fairness However, the core of Dota 2 is competition, back-and-forth play, and strategic depth Right now, the outcome of many matches is no longer determined by fair team competition, but by extreme differences in player skill and behavior amplified by the matchmaking system When these disparities become the dominant factor, the core competitive experience of the game is fundamentally broken This is a serious concern from a long-term paying player I expect this issue to be taken seriously, and for meaningful adjustments to be made to matchmaking, especially regarding skill balance and behavior filtering, instead of allowing the experience to continue degrading

title: URGENT Leshrac needs to be fixed + Plus 2026 general hero ability balance patch recommendations (lone druid, meepo, axe, warlock, outworld, wind, puck more etc)
body: ### Ability name Anything Pure damage, Ransack, Arcane Orb, Diabolic Edict, Golem Pure Fists etc ### Description I love to play Dota - I have played over 10, 000 games!!!! Every year more and more the game comes into balance. There are still some key heroes that are still too strong and are avoiding enough balance changes. With all these games I have noticed many themes that repeat and I will usually almost NEVER win against them. We also need to address the PURE DAMAGE mechanic being too strong. I have assembled a balance patch to address this and the reasons why. Lets start with Leshrac with this match ID 8535789981 - Legend 3.1k bracket lasting only 23 minutes! The Leshrac ends the game 23 - 3. Any hero dies INSTANTLY to his combo towards the end of the game. FYI in the last 200 games there has never been a ranked match that ended before 30 minutes. Before level 6 he just walks up on repeat and tanks the tower hitting me for way too much damage - there is nothing I can do my heroes all have spells with cooldowns but Leshrac has diabolic edict with a very long up time. Suggested fix: For the early game remove the talent Misanthropy - pushing towers with Lesh is dead for a long time - so that talent just makes him stronger for free. For all game change diabolic edict to Magical so players can mitigate the damage. The duration of diabolic edict change to scale length based on level so lv1 4 second duration, lv2 5, lv3 7, lv4 10 sec duration. Another suggested solution is to nerf his movement speed from 325 to 290 - there is simply no need for this hero to be so fast and own the game with a mana boots. Death Prophet - this hero is designed poorly and is the most durable hero in the game, no weak phase. You can see from the match ID she is often unkillable and this needs a fix: 8545476334 - I think if we remove the item eternal shroud things should come into balance - that item gives insane value for the price - less than 4000 gold for an item that gives 20% magic resist - 500 hp almost and further magic resist over time??? No way that item has to go. Even as mid any ability to beat her is thwarted by the bottle - the random rune spawn chance also is a problem and should be addressed. For a strategy game the amount of luck happening with the runes should be fixed. Lone Druid - The bear has too much hp from the start - it has no weak phase in the game. A Lone druid mid will always dominate - Dota should be a game focused on skill so I suggest we need to fix any hero that can dominate especially early on. The bear starts out with 1100 hp at level 1 - no hero does this - there is no counter play to this because your spells are level 1 or 2 and the bear heals and is denying your creeps and bullying you out of the lane. There is no weakness to this. Bug?: The Spirit Bear shows a stat gain of 0 across all fields, it states the bear has a max hp of 2000 but a level 30 bear has 4900 hp??? Why and how - there is no explanation from this it must be a CRITICAL bug and needs to be fixed. Suggested Fix: Change bear Hp from lv1 (1100 > 700) in balance with other heroes OR fix the bug giving it extra hp. Remove life steal completely so chipping the HP of the bear away with spells is rewarded. Remember we want to balance the early game - there should be no such thing as an early game hero in Dota - these make for uninteresting games that do not require skill. Make the cooldown to summon spirit bear start WHEN the bear dies. Outworld Destroyer - this hero can force denies on your range creep consistently on each creep wave with Astral Imprisonment this is too strong so he will always reach level 6 before you and as I said we want to remove the early game domination some heroes have and make it more about skill. More importantly his Arcane Orb is just too strong - he can easily deal 500 PURE damage PER HIT (1500 per second on good attack speed). I was playing tide hunter and his Arcane Orb was not being blocked at all by kraken shell. Suggested Fix: Cap the damage that Arcane Orb can do to 300 per hit or change damage type from pure to MAGICAL to fit in line with its name as being arcane and to help players mitigate the damage with magic resist. Again there is NO REASON he should have pure damage on his ability - Silencer's glaives were changed to magical and it's doing fine so for balance reason's OD should be balanced too. Puck - this hero is just TOO elusive with too much mobility and does TOO much damage - he can drag out a fight having players expend too much resources, and just when you think you've got him he will Euls and blink. He will also send the Illusory orb one way and go the opposite direction and teleport opposite to where you want. Suggested fix: Extend Blink dagger duration to 4 or 5 seconds to disable upon receiving hit damage, or if not then reduce phase shift to a flat 2 seconds, limit the maximum teleport range of illusory orb so puck can't go such massive distances in opposite. Axe - His blink initiation makes the game just too hard - a 3 second bkb piercing aoe stun on a 10 second cool down? He's so strong compared to other offlaners that immortal players say to climb out of 3k you MUST only play a select few offlaners - LC or Axe for their initiation etc. If you compare it to Tidehunter Axe is just better in every way more tankier and more fast paced game impact with a low cooldown ult being berserker's rage. Suggested solution: Remove the armor gain per kill OR reduce the stun duration to 2 seconds in line with most other stuns in the game. It should not pierce bkb etc OR if it keeps the 3 second duration it should not mute items so you can still use items like BKB etc which will protect you from the pure damage and culling blade effect. We have to keep axe in line with other Offlaners as having one or two heroes that are just better than the rest indicates a problem. Warlock - his ultimate and fatal bonds is too strong - more so than Witch Doctor and Disrupter because those other heroes have short duration but powerful ultimate's but what makes Warlock so strong is his Golem's last for way too long for an ultimate and create too much pressure and space within a team fight. They also dish out pure damage - again Dota can't be giving out pure damage for free there is no counter play. The fatal bonds sharing all this damage - it's just too much brain dead damage with no skill or drawback. In the middle of a team fight he is able to reliably land way too much damage, for way too long - this needs to be fixed. Suggested solution: The golem duration set to 15 second duration to fit in line with most other Dota abilities where you have a small window to use them. We can't have 60 second slow resistant, magic resistant, high hp, high damage units running around - that's not right it needs immediate fix. Their hp should fall to 2000 maximum, remove the level 25 80% magic resistance and 20 armor, replace with 10 second duration on Golem (maximum 25 seconds this way) and +2 second stun to first skill or +25% chance of 2 second stun from golems etc), remove slow resistance and change flaming fist from pure to magical. In addition remove fatal bonds completely - an 18 second AOE duration spell doing an additional 25% damage to multiple affected units is wrong for a skill. I suggest giving warlock a basic stun instead of 2 seconds OR at the very least change fatal bond duration to 6 seconds to fall in line with other abilities within the game. Beast Master - this hero wins EVERY game and our team just can't beat it - they are too strong in lane come online too fast and - their minions provide a free eye of skadi slow and he is able to end the game too fast. Suggested solution is to change primal roar from 4 second stun to 3 second stun and remove the slow completely. Also he ALWAYS rushes the Sceptre - the solution to fix this is to remove the +10 stacks gained from using Primal Roar and remove the healing given from the drums, the bonus damage per hit will be sufficient. Phantom Lancer - this hero requires specific counters and a good PL player rushes Heart, shard and aghs making him impossible to catch the real one and he is invisible. Having so much high hp makes the game easy. Another hero I rarely win against. This man can go all night long - which is against the norm for most heroes. Suggested solution: Remove the shard invisibility, remove the dispel he has - this is a flat no no - there is no basic dispel as an ability this must have been an oversight and change his ultimate to be an active that lasts 20 seconds with a cool down of 50 seconds so it has a 30 second down time to fit in line with other heroes. We have to be more understanding that a permanent up time ultimate is abusable. The illusions can be stronger during their 20 second window by way of taking less damage or dealing more damage but the 20 second window is required to fall in line with other heroes. Meepo - has always been strong - having 5 Units that all independently gain experience on an AGI hero means he will out level and be very tanky and he will force the game to end quicker than should be. The other problem is there is that PURE damage problem again - ransack deals pure damage for no reason and it's life steal. Suggested fix: remove mega meepo - the meepos are all very high hp tanky enemies with magic resistance, the success is to burst him down in team fights or catch one of his meepos out of position, he always has dig - he should not be able to drag his death out with Mega meepo. Change Ransack damage from pure to PHYSICAL. Change divided we stand magic resistance from 20% to 10%. Again he is too tanky and doesn't need more. Medusa - able to farm way too fast and hit multiple enemies, an ult that buys her more time to escape or deal more free damage - she is also notoriously difficult to kill because of the magic wand she carries. She completely countered my undying in lane - she should be able to go minus strength same as minus armour and die if enough decay stacks but I could no longer damage her in lane after getting her to 0 strength at all - completely countered me from the early game and I became useless in the later game.... Medusa also can flash farm - but doesn't buy bkb - this gives her an advantage over other carries that's a bit too much. Suggested solution: Just remove the mana shield and give her normal strength gain - Replace the mana shield with something else entirely perhaps an active ability that is similar to morphing wave form allowing her turn into a snake and slither 1000 units through the ground or something with a cool effect or perhaps the passive can be something akin to viper's attack slow etc. Making her need to buy BKB would help balance her in line other carries and this means she can't have full slots without any defensive items. Windranger - lucky last - this hero will get bkb so you can't blade mail and will now be permanently invisible. This basically guarantees a kill no brain no skill just blink and bkb and press ult and follow the hero you are killing. Suggested solution: remove the invisibility completely and damage reduction. Rework the scepter to something else entirely perhaps multi arrow shot with increased damage? Also increase the charge time for the arrow from 1 to 2 seconds. There is no balance in having a 1 second charge time skill that's long range deal 470 damage that's absurd. Change the arrow to 350 damage and make the sceptre deal 600 damage and throw three arrows with a small space between each other. Sand King - he has a reliable escape and buys blink and has one of the best ultimate's in the game. Bug: there appears to be a bug interaction with sentry where sand king can still hide and not be visible unless he is really close to the sentry - this needs to be fixed. Suggested solution: Remove the blind from sandstorm and increase invisibility fade after attacking to 1.3 seconds. The changes to blink dagger going on cooldown to 5 seconds as suggested earlier upon taking damage should balance this hero more. For epicenter remove the slow the damage and other effects are sufficient - you see most of the time sand king will blink then stun and ult you while right clicking - this is an insane amount of damage in such a short window and if you are slowed by 50% it's just too much so removing the slow will mean after you are stunned you can at least run. Sand storm duration should change to 12 seconds max duration to fall in line with other skills as having a 28 second duration spell on a 22 second cool down say WHAT? Again remove the blind. Queen Of Pain - picked in almost every game - in literally every role - the hero is too versatile - I will leave this up to the devs to sort this out however my suggested solution is the shadow strike is the problem - just looking at the skill it's a 16 second 55% slow on a 4 second cool down, provides tick damage and heals her??? That skill needs a full rework or at least it needs to remove some aspect such as the heal etc. The only other hero to have a slow this powerful is Veno and he is balanced by being very slow and squishy. QOP is a high mobility hero so this skill is a mistake design it's like having a Veno with this slow and high mobility. Pudge - this hero has way too much hp. He naturally buys shroud. Suggested solution: Consider just removing shroud from the game honestly, it provides too much hp + high magic resistance is not a combination we want to see in the game in one item. Make adjustments to flesh heap with 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1.0 consider removing the facet flesh heap that gives him strength when he ults. Juggernaught - I rarely win against this hero - his blade fury does way too much damage, is a dispel and he is immune to stuns. His laning stage is very secure - no counter play and he has a healing ward. suggested solution: Make him move slower during blade fury or reduce duration so it scale with level 3, 4 and 5 seconds and reduce damage from 80 down to 50 scaling with level. Chaos Knight - this hero is strong in all stages just too strong. Suggested solution: make lifesteal at 20%. And a last note for PA - permanent uptime ults have to go - same with PL - the game needs an element of skill - most heroes have cooldown and this is a good thing - to priorities skillful timing and coordination. PL and PA should have similar ults - a window of opportunity. There you have it - my list of the heroes i can think of that really NEED to be fixed. You can always know a hero has a problem when it's high in popularity or has a high win rate as people don't pick heroes they will lose with no matter how much they enjoy. The heroes on this list have been a pain for me my ENTIRE 10000+ games. They have never fallen in line EVER they have just always been strong. Either they are just too strong or the rest of the roster is weak - or has a major weakness limiting them. There are so many heroes right now in the game that are balanced - these are the last few. Maybe in the future Witch Doctor and Riki but those aren't TOO bad they are just strong. The heroes on THIS LIST I have written are way too strong and need to be changed. Thank you! ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) 8535789981

title: Introduce seasons for ranking as a way to enhance matchmaking and enforce behavior
body: ### Description Garbage matchmaking and terrible behavior deterrents are killing your game. Matchmakings has been plagued with one sided matches at almost every single rank level, several people complain of boosted or bought accounts being used by players to play out of their skill. In one fell swoop you could put all these services out of business by introducing seasonal ranks. 3 or 4 times a year the ranks reset, this hugely decreases the value of a boosted account. Who in their right mind will pay for an account they can only play at that level for 3 or 4 months, lets say even half a year. At the same time, if players are really invested in boosting their account every season, it wouldn't be hard to trace who those persons are as when they give their accounts away for someone else to boost, or when they switch between different accounts to play in, the person can only play in one account at the same time. Smurf accounts have always been a problem, pulling your punches to just try to avoid more smurfs is a cowardly way to not remediate either of the problems. This brings me to the other main issue plaguing your never growing numbers. Behavior enforcement. the current severity of punishments for bad behavior is completely useless... ono one is going to change their behavior because they don't get to request a coach, or their miniprofile is not available to be edited. There's only 3 things dota players care about. Ability to play the game mode you want, ability to chat (form which there is also a mute button which seems pointless to have a whole system), and hats (ability to wear ones own hats seeing as the random drops are mostly complete trash). For ability to play you could've already put in more severe restrictions of gameplay for repeat offenders. Longer cooldowns, restriction to certain modes or pools of players, etc. Devs could always ban players for longer periods of time, but nope, instead they half ass 1 day cooldowns, a seeming random shadow pool and LP, this si doing nothing for 12k BS players that still encounter toxic people that I guess not enough people report. Most players that have invested money on their hats will want to keep playing in THAT ACCOUNT, I see no reason why, like in CS or any other competitive game, permanent bans aren't more of a thing. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Dota Rocket Science
body: ### Description Hey DotA 2 Development Team and Community, I have amassed more than 20,000+ hours within DotA. Needless to say, I am a Professional if not more:) Recently, I decided to become the best I can be at the game. Being analytical as possible between every game either win or lose. My highest rating thus far is about Divine 4, which is about 5.4k **Solo** MMR. [My account is legitimate with legitimate active hours.]( The path towards a higher MMR rating is not straightforward and simple as "getting better" as there are factors outside of this that prevent the climb. A huge issue that I would like to address first and foremost is the Report System. There are 6-categories: Communication Abuse, Toxic Voice, Smurfing, Griefing, Cheating, and Role Abuse. Communication is a large part of the game especially when playing at a higher level. This applies to Toxic Voice as well. The option to select 'mute all', is more of a hinderance when it has to be applied. Players should not have to regulate others. Smurfing is a widespread issue. It appears that there are many accounts with less than 1,000 total matches, even 2,000 within each bracket. These accounts have low amount of MVPs, commends, and zero to no hours. Coincidence or not, these accounts are played and backed by players that are suspect to creating a hostile environment. Griefing can be considered anything that is "intended detriment" to the game and its players. However, there are many players that misuse the griefing option. The griefing option should not be a means to coerce nor dictate others. Cheating is an issue that can easily be undetected to the casual player. Role abuse is an option that does not serve the casual player. The Overwatch system is a system in which the community of DotA regulates itself. However, false reporting and account buying are issues that need to be addressed. The majority of the community of DotA players are not "professional". The average MMR of players are not all 3000, 4000, 5000 MMR. However, there are MANY accounts and players that have these ratings which do not reflect the appropriate skill. If there are players not in their respective skill bracket, players with access to reports and Overwatch will misuse the system. _Check my profile comments for legitimacy._ **With all of these issues; moving forward seems impossible.** **DotA is a game. Players should be able to play and enjoy DotA.** Defense of the Ancients is one thing, but defense against attacks from aliens as well.. Really? ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Large Aggregate of Issues/Feedback From Reddit/GitHub/Forum
body: ### Description Putting together this post to aggregate many of the issues in the game that have been highlighted over time and post TI. Please comment below with details of anything I might have missed, or any suggested improvements. ​ 1. Matchmaking 1. **Immortal Matchmaking** \- Immortal Matchmaking needs a version 2. It currently ignores all matchmaking options. This include - avoid a player functionality, Strict Solo Matchmaking, and Party Que. **Potential Improvement** \- An iteration of this would be to only use Immortal Draft at the highest MMR games, or enforce Drafting Parties and those parties would expend party ques. 2. **Smurfing/Account Buying** \- Accounts can now delete their overall matchmaking stats from their profiles. This means users have to look-up users on dotabuff/stratz, Steam Profile stats, and even checking Guilds, to really analyze if they are smurfing or not. If they are reported, nothing happens. This is especially relevant in party que as well as non-peak times (e.g. 9-5pm M-Fri on USE). Please change the name of Smurfing to Smurfing/Account/Buying 1. **Potential Improvement - 1.** Let Smurf account reports be reviewed by overwatch. Give a panel of details on the account (and their potential similar accounts) for the reviewer. This can include, common heros played, mutual friends, servers played, # of games played, time of day played, etc. If the account gets flagged, it should have a badge on the account indicating its a potential smurf account. 2. **Potential Improvement - 2.** Keep all account details in the account, included in these details should be (if a person is a high % of being a smurf) # of games where they were reported for smurfing. 3. **Potential Improvement - 3.** Communicate to reporters more regularly smurf indicators or false flags. If someone is reporting people that are clearly not smurfs, warn them, before they have a game limit on reports. 2. Behavior Score 1. **Infinite Reports -** Right now the "punishment" for excessively using the report system is not clear. We should have another score that indicates report accuracy. Ultimately if we are going to give scores to behavior & comms we should give scores to the enforcers as well. 1. **Potential Improvement - 1.** The lower the report accuracy the more limits on the degree of reporting a user has. Maybe by default a report has a "high" impact on the reported user, and people with low accuracy can only have "low" impact. 2. **Potential Improvement - 2.** Maybe one of the more severe punishments could be that you can only report for a certain area AFTER someone (with a higher score) reports that user first. 2. **Global Mutes Don't Follow New System** \- Details laid out [in this post]( But the TL;DR is that Communication Scores are not truly separated from Behavior Score. Comms can NEVER be higher than behavior score. Additionally regardless of your communication score you can be globally muted because you get enough reports and it has nothing to do with how much you chat or what you say, despite what the patch said. When you are globally muted you cant even /roll. If someone is muted and "griefing" their reports should all be reviewed by overwatch. This will heavily reduce peoples claims of being in the "trench" 1. **Potential Improvement - 1.** Do not let enemies report enemies for comm abuse, just let them mute enemies. 2. **Potential Improvement - 2.** If people report people for comms abuse that were previously muted, they should temporarily lose their ability to report for comms. 3. **Potential Improvement - 3.** Make all comm bans based off of the behavior score and # of games played, not time based. 3. Bugs (I am sure there are other bugs, these are just the ones I have experienced and seen similar highlights) 1. **Random Crashes are quite Frequent** \- MatchID (7421615721) - crash the instant Magnus's first spell was used at time pointer around 15 seconds before bounties spawned. I have noticed these type of crashes happening more frequently, something that used to be rare before the large map update 2. [**Users have to reverify game files**]( \- Since larger map update many of us are getting this issue, seemingly randomly. I have a top of the line system and still get these issues. Previously this re-verify thing would happen after any crash. Now it happens more seldomly but typically after some sort of game-update. I have already completely reinstalled Dota 2 3. **General Framerate Issues** \- I have a 5900X, 4090 and the latest drivers, and still run into random frame-rate issues. Kunka Aghs, MK Immortal Ult, are the most common ones. I think a great test Valve could run would be the Wraith King level in Aghs Lab... or the lag that was caused by Magnus skewering heroes off the Aghs Lab map. The dropped frames in these situations seems quite similar. 4. Gameplay 1. **Tiny Airlines works Again -** Noticed this in a game where someone decided to dual mid with me in Turbo. They picked Tiny and followed me around. I reported them and nothing happened. I disabled help, but they could still throw me. This was previously patched that if someone disabled help the throw skill would go on CD. 2. **Bottle Can Be Destroyed by Ally** \- Teammates can drop your bottle on the ground and destroy it. 3. **Balance Patches -** Big Tournaments (Like TI) should be the culmination of a game patch. Things that are exposed to be OP should be "hot patched" out so the gameplay continues to be fun. We know this is possible because it is often done in the "fun" game modes like diretide/aghs lab. For example, CK had a high winrate for some time, and then in the most recent minor patch he got buffed, his winrate shot-up from \~54% to 58% This should be seen as a regression and should have been quickly mitigated. 1. **Potential Improvement 1**. Keep the comms going, when the team posted the TI post/update there should have been an inclusion on balance patch coming after compendium closes (or something) 2. **Potential Improvement 2** \- Minor patches should be used more regularly to balance the game, these should be pre-planned for after big tournaments. 4. **Secondary Gamemode -** There is a strong sentiment across all channels that the most fun time to play dota is when there is a "chill" game mode outside of the main game. Aghs Lab is an example, but perhaps we can borrow an idea from Fortnite. They regularly rotate a few the most popular "Arcade" games into the main matchmaking. Perhaps we could consider doing something similar with a submission process. This also improves downtime between gameplay patches where people feel balance is poor. ​ ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_
