title: The new reporting system is being abused (+proof)
body: ### Description Since the update I have recieved 3 chatmutes, the newest one lasting for 30 ENTIRE DAYS, that all felt quite unjustified. I have written to steamsupport about this and they linked me this GitHub Page besides being useless as always. Since this is not an unban request forum I decided to test the points about the system being broken that I have made in my support request (screenshot below). Sadly I found one of them was actually true. These are all my Chat-Related reports from yesterday where 'action was taken', so I assume all of those people got a chat mute. (again, screenshots below, match ID's below are in order) **Spectre** - we won the game, he played well, but in a way that many not-pos-1-players hate, he farmed while periodically joining just to steal a kill with ult. In base siege he died more frequently than he maybe should have, considering his farm **Pudge** - we lost, he picked Pudge core (unpopular amongst the dota community), he went 5/10/10 and had >50% killparticipation on offlane **Phantom Assasin** - we lost, disconnected before the game started, came back at min 3, didnt get into game well, went 6/10/10 in 45 min as carry, won next game vs me with a good performance (even got 'action taken' on a 'griefing' report) **Jakiro 1** - same game as PA, wanted laneswap with muerta pos 4, still went 1/5/2 in lane, ended on 4/15/15 _---the whole PA and Jak 1 game was rough and some flaming happened but nothing notable---_ **Jakiro 2** - Horrible game all in all, all lanes lost, he went 2/12/8, wouldnt be surprised if everybody just reported everybody here Now whats the Problem here? I personally believe **NONE** of those people shouldve been muted for the games in question. I strategically issued the Chat reports during games or phases in which team morale was down and blaming (not in chat, in our teams' heads) was happening, to confirm my suspicion, that the new 'refined' **report system** is currently **being heavily abused** by the playerbase to **punish their teammates for having a bad game**. I am so sure of this, because as **steam support pointed out to me, reports are not persuaded if only one person reports**, therefore my other teammates also actively abused the system to punish someone they simply didnt like. While the players in question did obviously occasionally talk and complain, none of those complaints were 'disruptive behaviour', and should not be punished. The behaviour of using chat report like this, is something I also found when talking to other Dota players about my current 30 days ban. _I am therefore very sorry to everyone I reported_, I did this to prove my theory and hopefully change dota to the better with this request. I have also read the Summer-Update Blog post, and to me it seems that not only the 'malicious or toxic people' are being punished. Because regarding my findings above, the 'real-time' analysis of chat and voice chat is failing and you should in fact not have 'more confidence intaking action against bad actors' as most of the people you are currently 'taking action' against are in fact not 'bad actors' but simply players that have a bad game and are falsely reported. As someone who tries to use chat and voicechat as a means of communication in every game, this makes me and others that play like me, very vulnerable to bad games, because as soon as we make mistakes, we are likely to be reported and eventually punished for 'toxic behaviour' inspite of not actually being toxic. Should this post convince anybody in the development team that changes do indeed have to be made, I suggest removing all bans for now, as people that are actually toxic, will get banned again soon enough. As for what I have experienced, I think the time between one ban wearing off and being able to recieve a new one is far too short, as I basically got my 30 days shortly after the end of the 7 days before that. Last note: If you believe everything currently is as it should be, **AT LEAST** rework the mechanic that chat mute applies to party chat and in the same way to team chat in 5stack games. The people you can communicate with in those situations CHOSE to play with you and should therefore be able to communicate with you. **_If you are not responsible for dota development and agree with my point of view, please upvote this. This is not the only forum I will post this in. Playing without comms is not fun! Help us save Dota!_** ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) 7389006637 (Spec); 7389100423 (Pudge); 7389209797 (PA&Jak 1); 7389316688 (Jak 2) ### Screenshots![Screenshot 2023-10-20 125012](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](![grafik](

title: Valve, It's been over a month since the last Behavior Score Patch... Can we get another update?
body: ### Description Valve, did you already give-up on the new Behavior Score System? 1. Behavior Scores and Comms Scores are once again exactly the same (just like before the first update.) With thousands of potential pairs of scores, outside of the max 12k/12k it should be quite difficult, if not impossible, for the scores to always be the same. There is clearly a bug/abuse here. 2. People are getting lengthy communications bans, despite having extremely high communication scores (48 hours, to 1 week, to 1 month) and it appears the live "AI Driven" toxic chat detection only works for the instant game mutes, but not the collective comm abuse reports. I got comm banned (8400 comm score) for 30 days. Before the ban my comm scores were only going-up, so I figured my purposefully friendly comms were fine. However, it appears because they are not actually inspected, you can still get global mutes based off of # of reports. Saying in all chat "gg" lets the enemy report you for comm abuse. Picking dazzle mid and your teammates not liking it, earns you a comm report, etc. Since I have been muted for one month the past three Comms Scores have been as followed: [IMAGE]( Last three # of Comm Reports I literally can't type or use voice chat and I am getting reported most games (Note Toxic Comms and Toxic Voice are both bucketed into this column.) In the old system you were at least unable to report someone who was premuted. My assumption is people see I am pre-muted and report me accordingly, if I use the chat wheel and say get back, or ping someone is missing, they assume its with ill intent and that I am toxic, they then report me for other behaviors as they are triggered. Maybe we should hide that someone is auto muted (not including manual mutes) and remove the functionality of manually unmuting them until after the game. Prior to the comm ban my behavior score and comms score continually climbed (was at 8400 right before the ban and even when I got comm banned I gained 200 comms/behavior Score) now both scores are at 8000. 3. Please rework Global Mutes - In the new system we have strict restrictions at certain scores that enable specific type of mutes. Please lean on this system and adjust the bar appropriately. The Global mute system seems like a strange gate that is less clear when and why you are getting globally muted. Similarly, if you do get global muted, let people that are in Party Chat communicate without having to adjust mutes. 4. No action on smurf reports - What's the plan for smurf reports? I have seen nothing from the handful I have reported. At Divine->Immortal Its quite obvious when someone goes Lone Druid mid with 500 games that they are a smurf. Can we also enforce having # of matches and win % in someones profile? 5. Please remove denying bottles and let us know what exactly happened to the reported person- [I reported the natures prophet that I posted about]( and literally nothing happened. No action taken. But even if action was taken, I should at least know what happened (temporary ban + LP, LP, Shadow Pool, etc) ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_

title: Allow muting specific players in DotaTV
body: Please allow muting specific players in DotaTV chat. I would like to be able to use the chat without constant copy-paste spam or worse.
author: BenLubar

title: Tormentor notification
body: Right now there is an interaction with muted players and the reward (shard) from tormentor. If I have muted a player, regardless whether such player is ally or enemy, I cannot see the text notification saying the player has been awarded a shard for killing tormentor. There is no way this is intended. I want to mute the person, not the in-game notifications.
author: snpagliarini

title: I got DOTA 2 banned on my almost 5 years one and only steam account…
body: ### Description Hello, I would like to share a story, but first, let's get to know my name is Artur, I'm 25 years old, I live in Ukraine, I've been playing DotA for about 2-3 years, at first I had 6k integrity ( I have a weak PC), but after Russia's attack on Ukraine, I had to very often leave from games because of sirens and in half a year my decency from 8k became 1k for a long time I can’t raise it because I often played mostly low priority (sd mode), it was uncomfortable for me to play with eternal mute, the players there, to put it mildly, are very toxic and not friendly and there is no communication due to mutes, then I got 1 decency.. I didn’t know how to raise it because my PC was very weak and I often didn’t load or crashed, here’s my story for whom it’s not difficult like the post so that support can see and unblock.. thanks for your attention steam link I want to add that I'm not a booster I don't have any twink accounts I play for my own pleasure I have a crusader rank of 1 everything that was applied to me: Hello, Thank you for submitting additional information about your Dota 2 ban. This information will be forwarded to the Dota 2 team. Please note that you will not receive another response to this help request. Even though the Dota 2 team is unable to respond to individual inquiries, they review help requests submitted through this path. Please feel free to respond to this help request with any other information you would like to share about your ban. Even though help request tickets are automatically closed after 14 days with no activity, the contents of your help request will remain available for review by the Dota 2 team and will remain associated with your account. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) _No response_ ### Screenshots![ASDDASDSAD213DASADS](![dasdasdsadsadsaadsdas](![dasadsadsdasdsadsaadsdas123123](![dasdsadsadsaddcsaadsdasdas123132](
